title: AI-Driven Electrical Machine Design: From Surrogate-Assisted Optimization to Trustworthy, Manufacturable, and Sustainable Design Workflows
authors: Loránd Szabó
abstract: Electrical machine design faces growing constraints from power density, wide operating ranges, thermal and mechanical limits, acoustics, manufacturability, cost, and critical material availability. While finite element and multi-physics simulations remain essential, their direct use in population-based or multi-objective optimization is often computationally prohibitive. AI, spanning surrogate modeling, machine learning, deep learning, physics-informed networks, Bayesian optimization, and emerging generative methods, is increasingly used to accelerate analysis, enlarge design spaces, and support inverse or multi-objective tasks. This review examines AI-assisted electrical machine design from a workflow perspective, distinguishing functional approximation, performance prediction, topology-aware learning, physics-informed modeling, active learning, and robust optimization under uncertainty. It highlights current limitations, including narrow topology coverage, reliance on FEM-generated data, weak extrapolation, limited uncertainty reporting, scarce experimental validation, and insufficient attention to manufacturability and sustainability. A design-readiness framework and minimum reporting checklist are proposed to improve trustworthiness and reusability. The review concludes that AI should serve as a physics-aware, validation-dependent accelerator, complementing, not replacing, electromagnetic expertise, multi-physics simulation, and prototype testing.

infographic.key_insight: AI can speed up electrical machine design by acting as a physics-aware surrogate and optimization aid, but it must remain grounded in simulation and experimental validation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The work is relevant to designing high-performance machines that satisfy power density, thermal, mechanical, acoustic, manufacturability, cost, and sustainability constraints.
method: Surrogate modeling and machine learning to approximate FEM-based performance.
Physics-informed and Bayesian methods for uncertainty-aware prediction and optimization.
Active learning and emerging generative approaches for inverse and multi-objective design.
infographic.evidence_signal: The review synthesizes workflow-level evidence from simulation-driven and AI-assisted design studies, while noting that reported validation is often limited and data are frequently generated by FEM.
infographic.watch_item: A key concern is weak extrapolation beyond training topologies and insufficient reporting of uncertainty, manufacturability, and experimental verification.
infographic.paper_title: AI-Driven Electrical Machine Design: From Surrogate-Assisted Optimization to Trustworthy, Manufacturable, and Sustainable Design Workflows

zh-Hans.title: AI驱动的电机设计：从代理辅助优化到可信、可制造且可持续的设计工作流
zh-Hans.abstract: 电机设计面临日益严苛的约束，包括功率密度、宽工作范围、热与机械极限、噪声声学、可制造性、成本以及关键材料可获得性。尽管有限元和多物理场仿真仍然至关重要，但将其直接用于基于种群的优化或多目标优化时，计算代价往往高得难以承受。人工智能（AI）涵盖代理模型、机器学习、深度学习、物理信息网络、贝叶斯优化以及新兴的生成式方法，正越来越多地用于加速分析、扩展设计空间，并支持逆向或多目标任务。本综述从工作流视角考察了AI辅助电机设计，区分了功能逼近、性能预测、拓扑感知学习、物理信息建模、主动学习以及不确定性下的鲁棒优化。文章强调了当前局限，包括拓扑覆盖面狭窄、对FEM生成数据的依赖、外推能力弱、不确定性报告不足、实验验证稀缺，以及对可制造性和可持续性关注不够。文中提出了设计就绪度框架和最低报告清单，以提升可信度和可复用性。综述最后指出，AI应作为一种具备物理认知、依赖验证的加速器，与电磁专业知识、多物理场仿真和原型测试形成互补，而非取而代之。

infographic.key_insight: AI可以通过充当具备物理认知的代理模型和优化辅助来加速电机设计，但必须始终建立在仿真和实验验证的基础之上。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该工作与设计高性能电机相关，这些电机需要满足功率密度、热、机械、声学、可制造性、成本和可持续性等约束。
method: 采用代理建模和机器学习来逼近基于FEM的性能。
采用物理信息方法和贝叶斯方法进行考虑不确定性的预测与优化。
采用主动学习和新兴生成式方法开展逆向设计与多目标设计。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该综述综合了来自仿真驱动和AI辅助设计研究的工作流层面证据，同时指出已报告的验证通常有限，且数据经常由FEM生成。
infographic.watch_item: 一个关键问题是对训练拓扑之外的外推能力较弱，以及对不确定性、可制造性和实验验证的报告不足。

title: Microstructure, Sliding Wear, and Electrochemical Corrosion of a High-Entropy Alloy–Cermet Composite Thermal Spray Coating
authors: Stavros Kiape, Anthoula Poulia, Dimitrios Nousias, Ε. Georgatis, Spyros Kamnis, Theodore E. Matikas
abstract: This study investigates the design, microstructure, and performance profile of a novel composite coating combining a high-entropy alloy (HEA) matrix with cermet reinforcement. A 50wt.%CoCrFeMnNi0.8V–50wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 powder mixture was successfully deposited onto steel substrates via high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) thermal spraying. Microstructural analysis revealed a highly dense, well-bonded coating architecture (450–500 μm thick) where partially melted, spherical HEA splats were uniformly surrounded by the Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 phase. X-ray diffraction confirmed a complex multiphase evolution consisting of FCC, BCC, and σ-NiCr phases driven by the rapid solidification inherent to the HVOF process. Tribological evaluations via ball-on-disc testing demonstrated that incorporating the Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 reinforcement significantly improves wear resistance compared to the monolithic HEA coating. The composite’s wear behavior is governed by a synergistic mechanism: the ductile HEA matrix accommodates plastic deformation, while the harder carbide particles enhance load-bearing capacity, transitioning from adhesive wear to mild third-body abrasion and protective tribo-oxidation. Conversely, electrochemical testing in a 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution showed that the composite coating exhibits higher corrosion current densities (10.53 × 10−6 A/cm2) and more active corrosion potentials than the pure HEA matrix. This behavior is attributed to localized micro-galvanic cells forming at the heterogeneous interfaces between the different phases, alongside chloride-induced destabilization of the surface oxide film. Overall, the novel composite coating offers a compelling, sustainable alternative for surface engineering applications requiring a balanced trade-off between mechanical toughness and acceptable environmental durability. This behavior is also verified by the comparison with previous results dealing with monolithic CoCrFeMnNi0.8V and 75wt.%CoCrFeMnNi0.8V–25wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 thermal sprayed coatings, where it is evident that the increase of the reinforcing phase leads to an optimum combination of properties.

infographic.key_insight: Adding Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 to a CoCrFeMnNi0.8V HEA HVOF coating creates a dense, wear-resistant composite, but it also makes the coating more prone to chloride corrosion.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The coating is promising for surfaces needing high wear resistance and toughness, but designers must balance tribological gains against reduced electrochemical durability in salty environments.
method: HVOF-sprayed a 50 wt.% HEA / 50 wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20 powder blend onto steel.
Examined microstructure and phase evolution with microscopy and XRD.
Compared wear performance by ball-on-disc testing and corrosion behavior in 3.5 wt.% NaCl.
infographic.evidence_signal: The composite coating was 450–500 μm thick, showed dense well-bonded multiphase microstructure, improved wear resistance, and had a corrosion current density of 10.53 × 10^-6 A/cm² in NaCl.
infographic.watch_item: The heterogeneous phase structure that improves wear can also promote micro-galvanic corrosion, so environmental exposure limits should be checked before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Sliding Wear, and Electrochemical Corrosion of a High-Entropy Alloy–Cermet Composite Thermal Spray Coating

zh-Hans.title: 高熵合金-金属陶瓷复合热喷涂涂层的显微组织、滑动磨损与电化学腐蚀
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了一种新型复合涂层的设计、显微组织及性能特征，该涂层将高熵合金（HEA）基体与金属陶瓷（cermet）增强相相结合。采用高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）工艺，成功将50wt.%CoCrFeMnNi0.8V–50wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20粉末混合物沉积到钢基体上。显微组织分析表明，该涂层结构致密、结合良好，厚度为450–500 μm，其中部分熔化的球形HEA扁平颗粒均匀分布于Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20相周围。X射线衍射证实，由HVOF过程固有的快速凝固所驱动，涂层形成了由FCC、BCC和σ-NiCr相组成的复杂多相演化。通过球-盘摩擦磨损测试进行的摩擦学评估表明，与单一HEA涂层相比，加入Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20增强相可显著提高耐磨性。该复合材料的磨损行为由协同机制控制：延性HEA基体可承受塑性变形，而更硬的碳化物颗粒提高了承载能力，使磨损机制由黏着磨损转变为轻微三体磨粒磨损和保护性摩擦氧化。相反，在3.5 wt.% NaCl溶液中的电化学测试表明，该复合涂层的腐蚀电流密度更高（10.53 × 10−6 A/cm2），且腐蚀电位更活泼于纯HEA基体。该行为归因于不同相之间异质界面处形成的局部微电偶，同时伴随氯离子诱导的表面氧化膜失稳。总体而言，这种新型复合涂层为需要在机械韧性与可接受环境耐久性之间取得平衡的表面工程应用提供了一种具有吸引力且可持续的替代方案。与先前关于单一CoCrFeMnNi0.8V以及75wt.%CoCrFeMnNi0.8V–25wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20热喷涂涂层的结果比较也证实了这一点，表明增强相含量的增加有助于获得性能的最佳组合。

infographic.key_insight: 向CoCrFeMnNi0.8V HEA HVOF涂层中加入Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20，可形成致密、耐磨的复合涂层，但也会使涂层更易发生氯化物腐蚀。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层适用于需要高耐磨性和韧性的表面，但设计时必须权衡摩擦学性能提升与盐环境下电化学耐久性降低之间的关系。
method: 采用HVOF将50 wt.% HEA / 50 wt.% Cr3C2-Ni80Cr20粉末混合物喷涂到钢基体上。
通过显微镜和XRD分析显微组织及相演化。
通过球-盘磨损测试比较耐磨性能，并在3.5 wt.% NaCl中评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该复合涂层厚度为450–500 μm，呈现致密且结合良好的多相显微组织，耐磨性提高，并在NaCl中的腐蚀电流密度为10.53 × 10^-6 A/cm²。
infographic.watch_item: 有助于提高耐磨性的异质相结构也可能促进微电偶腐蚀，因此在部署前应检查环境暴露限值。

title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior
authors: Sneha Samal, Shrikant Joshi, Stefan Björklund, Mohit Chandra, Akhil Bhardwaj, Jaromír Kopeček
abstract: Depositing various coatings on surface of engineering components with the aim to improve their performance concerning wear, corrosion, friction and thermal protection is already a standard practice. Depositing metallic NiTi shape memory alloy coatings may be a viable alternative for hard ceramic coatings. NiTi coatings offer additional benefits originating from unique functional thermomechanical properties. However, fabrication of thick NiTi coatings turned out to be difficult. Standard electroplating and laser cladding methods are not suitable for NiTi the most widely used plasma spray methods tend to produce chemically inhomogeneous coatings that do not transform martensitically, cold sprayed NiTi coatings suffer from poor adhesion to the substrates. In this work we report on first ever successful fabrication of thick NiTi coatings (100-300 um) that display functional thermomechanical properties and simultaneously show very good adherence to the substrate. We used high velocity air fuel thermal spray method to fabricate NiTi coatings deposited on mild steel using four different sets of processing parameters. Chemical composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation and functional thermomechanical properties of the NiTi coatings were evaluated. Although the coatings contain inhomogeneous microstructure, voids, oxide particles, high density of dislocation defects and internal stress, they undergo martensitic transformation upon cooling and or mechanical loading. As sprayed NiTi coatings need to be annealed to display functional thermomechanical properties. Despite their limited tensile strength, the coatings displayed thermal actuation in 3 point bending tests and shape memory effects in nanoindentation and scratch tests.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF spraying can produce thick NiTi coatings that retain martensitic transformation and shape-memory functionality after post-annealing, despite significant as-sprayed defects.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a practical route to add functional, thermally responsive NiTi surfaces on steel components for actuation, smart repair, or adaptive wear-protection applications.
method: HVAF-sprayed NiTi onto mild steel using four processing parameter sets.
Characterized composition, porosity, microstructure, phase transformation, and thermomechanical behavior.
Evaluated functional response with 3-point bending, nanoindentation, and scratch testing.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that 100–300 μm coatings showed martensitic transformation and measurable thermal actuation/shape memory behavior after annealing, with good substrate adhesion.
infographic.watch_item: As-sprayed coatings are microstructurally inhomogeneous and defect-rich, so annealing and process control are critical to achieve reliable functional performance.
infographic.paper_title: HVAF Spraying of NiTi Coatings: Microstructure, Phase Transformation and Shape Memory Behavior

zh-Hans.title: HVAF喷涂NiTi涂层：显微组织、相变与形状记忆行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 在工程部件表面沉积各种涂层以提高其在耐磨、耐腐蚀、减摩和热防护方面的性能，已是一种标准做法。沉积金属NiTi形状记忆合金涂层可能是硬质陶瓷涂层的一种可行替代方案。NiTi涂层还具有源于独特功能性热机械性能的额外优势。然而，厚NiTi涂层的制备一直很困难。标准电镀和激光熔覆方法不适用于NiTi；目前最广泛使用的等离子喷涂方法往往会产生化学成分不均匀且不发生马氏体转变的涂层，而冷喷NiTi涂层则存在与基体黏附性差的问题。在本研究中，我们报道了首次成功制备出既具有功能性热机械性能、又同时与基体具有很好结合性的厚NiTi涂层（100-300 um）。我们采用高速空气燃料热喷涂方法，在低碳钢基体上以四组不同工艺参数制备NiTi涂层。对NiTi涂层的化学成分、孔隙率、显微组织、相变以及功能性热机械性能进行了评价。尽管这些涂层具有不均匀的显微组织、孔洞、氧化物颗粒、高密度位错缺陷和内应力，但它们在冷却和/或机械载荷作用下仍会发生马氏体转变。喷涂态NiTi涂层需要退火后才能表现出功能性热机械性能。尽管其拉伸强度有限，这些涂层在三点弯曲试验中表现出热致驱动效应，并在纳米压痕和划痕试验中表现出形状记忆效应。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂可以制备厚NiTi涂层；经过后续退火后，尽管喷涂态存在显著缺陷，仍可保留马氏体转变和形状记忆功能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为在钢构件上增加具有功能性、热响应性的NiTi表面提供了一条实用途径，可用于驱动、智能修复或自适应耐磨防护等应用。
method: 采用HVAF在低碳钢上以四组工艺参数制备NiTi涂层。
表征成分、孔隙率、显微组织、相变和热机械行为。
通过三点弯曲、纳米压痕和划痕测试评估功能响应。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，100–300 μm涂层在退火后表现出马氏体转变以及可测量的热致驱动/形状记忆行为，并且与基体结合良好。
infographic.watch_item: 喷涂态涂层显微组织不均匀且缺陷丰富，因此退火和工艺控制对于获得可靠的功能性能至关重要。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation plus ANN surrogate model can accurately predict friction stir welding quality of HDPE and identify process windows that avoid defects.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study gives practical welding guidelines by linking rotational speed, travel speed, and bottom preheating to thermal stability, axial force, and void formation in thermoplastic joining.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE friction stir welding
Experimental validation across varying rotational speed, welding speed, and bottom preheating
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained to predict temperature and axial force responses
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved strong predictive performance with R2 values of 0.91 to 0.99, and the CEL model matched experimental thermal, mechanical, and defect trends.
infographic.watch_item: The process maps are based on the tested HDPE parameter space, so broader use on other tool geometries, thicknesses, or polymers may require retraining and revalidation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯摩擦搅拌焊中焊缝质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）已被公认为一种高效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究通过计算方法与机器学习方法，结合实验结果验证，系统研究了高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）摩擦搅拌焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征的预测。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟在不同工艺参数——转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件——下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型与实验数据进行了验证，在空洞形成、热响应和力学响应预测方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，峰值下压力从接近1600 N降低至约1100 N，而峰值温度则从70 °C（无预热）提高到约100 °C，从而使厚度方向梯度更加平缓并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时间响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和良好的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机影响区和热影响区；同时，组合的CEL–ANN框架可快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min并采用60 °C预热时获得最佳条件，而在无预热且1000 rpm条件下由于虫洞形成而表现出较差的焊接性。这些研究结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指南，并表明将计算建模与机器学习相结合能够实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 耦合CEL仿真加ANN代理模型可准确预测HDPE摩擦搅拌焊质量，并识别可避免缺陷的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将转速、行进速度和底部预热与热稳定性、轴向力和空洞形成联系起来，给出了实用的焊接指南。
method: HDPE摩擦搅拌焊的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
在不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下进行实验验证
训练两个多层感知机ANN以预测温度和轴向力响应
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型取得了0.91至0.99的R2值，表现出很强的预测性能；CEL模型与实验中的热、力学和缺陷趋势一致。
infographic.watch_item: 这些工艺图基于所测试的HDPE参数空间，因此若应用于其他工具几何、厚度或聚合物，可能需要重新训练和重新验证。

title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
authors: Yue Cao, Hai Lin, YuMing Zhang
abstract: Arc welding processes are essential for continuous fabrication but prone to disturbances that impair weld quality, making real-time monitoring critical yet difficult due to complex visual patterns and nonlinear, time-varying dynamics. Deep learning shows promise but faces scalability limits because of its dependence on large labeled datasets and application-specific tuning. We explore whether a unified approach can characterize major arc welding processes across applications and improve scalability through consistent state monitoring. This paper introduces a robust and generalizable monitoring framework for arc welding. It combines unsupervised deep latent representation learning, which extracts compact features from weld pool images, with Bayesian filtering to handle persistent and fluctuating disturbances such as arc radiation and specular reflections. Specifically, a Dynamic Variational Autoencoder (DVAE), consisting of a CNN-based encoder-decoder and an LSTM-based transition model, jointly learns latent representations and their evolution under control inputs. For robust real-time inference, a specialized Particle Filter (PF) propagates the latent and LSTM hidden states, preserving process history while suppressing sensor noise. This design is well suited to welding's slow and inertial dynamics. Validation on GTAW and GMAW without process-specific tuning demonstrates the framework's generalizability and robustness.

infographic.key_insight: A unified DVAE + particle filter framework can monitor multiple arc welding processes robustly by learning latent weld-state dynamics from images and filtering out visual disturbances in real time.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This improves scalable, cross-process welding quality monitoring without heavy labeled data or application-specific model tuning, supporting more reliable automation.

infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on careful particle-filter design and adequate image quality, since strong arc radiation and specular reflections can still challenge latent-state inference.

zh-Hans.title: 具有DVAE和粒子滤波器的电弧焊过程鲁棒监测：一种可泛化框架
zh-Hans.abstract: 电弧焊过程是连续制造中的关键环节，但易受扰动影响焊缝质量，因此实时监测至关重要。然而，由于复杂的视觉模式和非线性、时变动力学，这一任务也十分困难。深度学习虽展现出潜力，但由于依赖大量标注数据并需要针对具体应用进行调参，其可扩展性受到限制。我们探讨一种统一方法能否跨应用表征主要电弧焊过程，并通过一致的状态监测提升可扩展性。本文提出一种用于电弧焊的鲁棒且可泛化监测框架。该框架将无监督深度潜在表征学习与贝叶斯滤波相结合：前者从熔池图像中提取紧凑特征，后者处理持续性和波动性扰动，如电弧辐射和镜面反射。具体而言，动态变分自编码器（DVAE）由基于CNN的编码器-解码器和基于LSTM的转移模型组成，在控制输入作用下联合学习潜在表示及其演化。为实现鲁棒的实时推断，专门设计的粒子滤波器（PF）传播潜在状态和LSTM隐藏状态，在抑制传感器噪声的同时保留过程历史。该设计非常适合焊接缓慢且具有惯性的动态特性。在GTAW和GMAW上的验证表明，在无需针对具体过程调参的情况下，该框架仍具有良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。

infographic.key_insight: 统一的DVAE + 粒子滤波器框架可以通过从图像中学习潜在焊接状态动力学并实时滤除视觉扰动，鲁棒地监测多种电弧焊过程。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这有助于在不过度依赖标注数据或针对特定应用进行模型调参的情况下，实现可扩展、跨过程的焊接质量监测，从而支持更可靠的自动化。
method: CNN编码器-解码器从熔池图像中学习紧凑的潜在特征
LSTM转移模型在控制输入作用下捕捉潜在状态演化
粒子滤波器传播潜在状态和隐藏状态，以抑制噪声并保留过程历史
infographic.evidence_signal: 该框架在GTAW和GMAW上得到验证，并据报道无需针对具体过程调参即可工作，表明其在不同焊接模式下具有泛化性和鲁棒性。
infographic.watch_item: 性能可能依赖于粒子滤波器的精心设计和足够的图像质量，因为强烈的电弧辐射和镜面反射仍可能对潜在状态推断构成挑战。

title: Optimization and Tribological Evaluation of Plasma-Sprayed Cr3C2 and Stellite Coatings on Inconel 625 using Taguchi-ANOVA Method
authors: Satheesh Kumar S, Velmurugan S, Janaki S, C Ramesh
abstract: Superalloys used in aerospace and power generation industries are frequently exposed to severe thermal and tribological conditions, resulting in significant wear loss. In this study, carbide-based Cr3C2 and Stellite coatings were deposited on Inconel 625 substrates using the Atmospheric Plasma Spray (APS) process to improve wear resistance. The microstructural characteristics, hardness, friction, and wear behaviour of coated and uncoated specimens were systematically evaluated. SEM analysis revealed uniform coating deposition with strong interfacial bonding and no visible pores or microcracks. EDAX results confirmed the presence of major alloying elements, including nickel, chromium, and carbon in Cr3C2 coatings, while Stellite coatings showed high chromium and carbon content. The plasma-sprayed Cr3C2 coating increased the surface hardness from 505 HV for the uncoated Inconel 625 substrate to 720 HV, corresponding to a 42.6% increase, while the Stellite coating achieved 669 HV, representing a 32.5% increase. The Cr3C2 coating exhibited the lowest wear loss of 0.2% and the minimum specific wear rate at 200 °C, indicating superior tribological performance under elevated-temperature conditions. Compared with the uncoated substrate, both coatings significantly reduced the specific wear rate, with the Cr3C2 coating demonstrating the greatest improvement in wear resistance. Taguchi L9 and ANOVA analyses confirmed coating type as the most influential parameter affecting wear performance.
venue: Transactions of the Canadian Society for Mechanical Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Plasma-sprayed Cr3C2 and Stellite coatings significantly improve Inconel 625 wear resistance, with Cr3C2 giving the best hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support APS carbide-based coatings as a practical surface-engineering route for aerospace and power-generation components exposed to high-temperature wear.
method: APS deposited Cr3C2 and Stellite coatings on Inconel 625 substrates
Evaluated microstructure, hardness, friction, and wear using SEM, EDAX, and tribological testing
Used Taguchi L9 design with ANOVA to identify key wear-performance drivers

infographic.paper_title: Optimization and Tribological Evaluation of Plasma-Sprayed Cr3C2 and Stellite Coatings on Inconel 625 using Taguchi-ANOVA Method

zh-Hans.title: 采用Taguchi-ANOVA方法对等离子喷涂Cr3C2和司太立涂层在Inconel 625上的优化与摩擦学评价
zh-Hans.abstract: 航空航天和发电工业中使用的超合金经常暴露于严苛的热和摩擦学条件下，导致显著的磨损损失。本研究采用大气等离子喷涂（Atmospheric Plasma Spray, APS）工艺在Inconel 625基体上沉积基于碳化物的Cr3C2和司太立（Stellite）涂层，以提高耐磨性。系统评估了涂层与未涂层试样的微观组织特征、硬度、摩擦和磨损行为。SEM分析显示涂层沉积均匀，界面结合强，没有可见孔隙或微裂纹。EDAX结果证实Cr3C2涂层中存在镍、铬和碳等主要合金元素，而司太立涂层表现出较高的铬和碳含量。等离子喷涂Cr3C2涂层将表面硬度从未涂层Inconel 625基体的505 HV提高到720 HV，相当于提高了42.6%；而司太立涂层达到669 HV，增幅为32.5%。Cr3C2涂层在200 °C下表现出最低的磨损损失0.2%和最小的比磨损率，表明其在高温条件下具有更优的摩擦学性能。与未涂层基体相比，两种涂层均显著降低了比磨损率，其中Cr3C2涂层在耐磨性方面的改善最大。Taguchi L9和ANOVA分析证实，涂层类型是影响磨损性能的最关键参数。

infographic.key_insight: 等离子喷涂Cr3C2和司太立涂层可显著提高Inconel 625的耐磨性，其中Cr3C2在硬度和摩擦学性能方面表现最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 结果支持APS碳化物涂层作为一种适用于暴露于高温磨损环境的航空航天和发电部件的实用表面工程路径。

infographic.evidence_signal: Cr3C2将硬度从505 HV提高到720 HV，并在200 °C下实现了最低的磨损损失（0.2%）和最小的比磨损率。

title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network
authors: Keonvin Park, Yong Ann Voeurn, Hyeokjun Kweon, Doyun Lee
abstract: Reliable seam segmentation is essential for autonomous robotic welding in construction, where harsh illumination, specular reflections, and thin weld geometries often degrade segmentation performance. This study proposes a reflection-robust seam segmentation framework that enhances a BiSeNetV2 backbone through transfer learning and a hybrid Cross-Entropy--Lovász loss. Rather than increasing architectural complexity, the proposed framework improves reflection robustness through learning-stability-oriented optimization. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 81.76\% Joint IoU and 90.73\% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by +22.36 percentage points over the OHEM-based baseline while maintaining identical FLOPs, parameter count, and inference speed. The proposed approach also recovers 96.33\% of severe zero-IoU failure cases under reflective conditions. Comparative experiments across BiSeNetV2, DeepLabV3+, UNet, and SegFormer further demonstrate that the proposed optimization strategy is particularly effective for lightweight real-time segmentation architectures. Qualitative analyses additionally show improved seam continuity and reflection robustness in challenging welding environments. These findings suggest that the proposed framework provides a practical and lightweight perception solution for robotic welding applications involving reflective metallic surfaces.

infographic.key_insight: A lightweight transfer-learning and hybrid Cross-Entropy–Lovász loss upgrade to BiSeNetV2 substantially improves weld seam segmentation robustness under strong reflections without increasing model complexity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable real-time perception for construction welding robots, helping maintain seam tracking on shiny, harshly illuminated metal surfaces.
method: Fine-tuned a BiSeNetV2 backbone via transfer learning for seam segmentation.
Used a hybrid Cross-Entropy + Lovász loss to stabilize learning and improve boundary quality.
Kept FLOPs, parameters, and inference speed unchanged versus the baseline.

zh-Hans.title: 通过迁移学习增强用于建筑自动焊接机器人的焊缝分割：应对双边分割网络的局限性
zh-Hans.abstract: 在建筑环境中的自主机器人焊接中，可靠的焊缝分割至关重要；然而，恶劣照明、镜面反射以及细窄的焊缝几何形态常常会降低分割性能。本研究提出一种抗反射的焊缝分割框架，通过迁移学习和混合 Cross-Entropy--Lovász 损失对 BiSeNetV2 主干网络进行增强。与其增加架构复杂度，不如通过面向学习稳定性的优化来提升反射鲁棒性。实验结果表明，所提出的方法实现了 81.76% 的 Joint IoU 和 90.73% 的 mIoU，在保持 FLOPs、参数量和推理速度完全不变的情况下，相比基于 OHEM 的基线，Joint IoU 提升了 +22.36 个百分点。所提出的方法还恢复了在反射条件下 96.33% 的严重零 IoU 失败案例。针对 BiSeNetV2、DeepLabV3+、UNet 和 SegFormer 的对比实验进一步表明，该优化策略对轻量级实时分割架构尤其有效。定性分析还显示，在具有挑战性的焊接环境中，焊缝连续性和反射鲁棒性均有所提升。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为涉及反光金属表面的机器人焊接应用提供了一种实用且轻量级的感知解决方案。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 这使建筑焊接机器人能够进行更可靠的实时感知，有助于在光亮、强光照的金属表面上保持焊缝跟踪。
method: 通过迁移学习对 BiSeNetV2 主干网络进行微调，用于焊缝分割。
采用混合 Cross-Entropy + Lovász 损失以稳定学习并提高边界质量。
与基线相比，保持 FLOPs、参数量和推理速度不变。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所提出的方法达到了 81.76% 的 Joint IoU 和 90.73% 的 mIoU，相比 OHEM 基线，Joint IoU 提升了 +22.36 个百分点，并恢复了 96.33% 的严重零 IoU 失败案例。

title: Tribological enhancement of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun coated Ti-6Al-4V alloy: A machine learning approach
authors: Selwyn Jebadurai Devaraj, A. Arul Jeya Kumar, A Queen Alice, V Manoj Kumar, S Arokya Agustin, A Sarath Chandra
abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloy is used a lot in aerospace, biomedical and marine applications. This study investigates the tribological behaviour of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coated and uncoated Ti-6Al-4V alloy by experimental and machine learning approaches. An Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 ceramic coating, approximately 200 µm thick, was applied to Ti-6Al-4V alloy via the detonation gun (D-gun) process under regulated conditions (oxygen flow: 4800 SLPH, acetylene: 2150 SLPH, stand-off distance: 180 mm, particle velocity ∼1200 m/s). The wear behaviour of samples was tested using a pin-on-disc apparatus in accordance with ASTM G99 standards. Tests were conducted under normal loads of 40–100 N, sliding speeds of 100–200 rpm and durations of 20–40 min against an EN31 steel counter face. Scanning electron microscopy demonstrated that coated surfaces exhibited reduced wear and formed a protective tribo-layer. Machine learning models such as artificial neural networks, K-nearest neighbours and random forest were developed to predict wear based on sliding parameters. Random forest proved to be the best choice with less mean percentage error and mean squared error. The results showed that D-gun deposited Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coatings improved the wear performance of Ti-6Al-4V.
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

infographic.key_insight: A D-gun applied Al2O3–TiO2 ceramic coating significantly improves the wear resistance of Ti-6Al-4V, and random forest best predicts wear from sliding conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work supports using detonation-sprayed ceramic coatings to extend the service life of Ti-6Al-4V components in aerospace, biomedical, and marine tribological applications.

Evaluated wear with ASTM G99 pin-on-disc tests under 40–100 N, 100–200 rpm, and 20–40 min against EN31 steel.
Trained ANN, KNN, and random forest models to map sliding parameters to wear.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental microscopy showed reduced wear and tribo-layer formation on coated samples, while random forest had the lowest mean percentage error and mean squared error among the tested models.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on a limited test matrix and a specific coating/process window, so broader generalization to other loads, speeds, substrates, or service environments still needs validation.
infographic.paper_title: Tribological enhancement of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun coated Ti-6Al-4V alloy: A machine learning approach

zh-Hans.title: Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun 涂层 Ti-6Al-4V 合金的摩擦学增强：一种机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V 合金广泛用于航空航天、生物医学和海洋应用。本研究通过实验和机器学习方法，研究了 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层与未涂层 Ti-6Al-4V 合金的摩擦学行为。在受控条件下（氧气流量：4800 SLPH、乙炔：2150 SLPH、喷距：180 mm、粒子速度约 1200 m/s），采用爆炸喷涂枪（D-gun）工艺在 Ti-6Al-4V 合金上制备了约 200 µm 厚的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 陶瓷涂层。按照 ASTM G99 标准，使用销盘式装置测试了样品的磨损行为。试验在对磨材料为 EN31 钢的条件下，于 40–100 N 的法向载荷、100–200 rpm 的滑动速度以及 20–40 min 的持续时间内进行。扫描电子显微镜结果表明，涂层表面磨损较小，并形成了保护性的摩擦层。建立了人工神经网络、K 近邻和随机森林等机器学习模型，以基于滑动参数预测磨损。随机森林被证明是最佳选择，其平均百分误差和均方误差更低。结果表明，D-gun 沉积的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层提高了 Ti-6Al-4V 的耐磨性能。

infographic.key_insight: D-gun 制备的 Al2O3–TiO2 陶瓷涂层可显著提高 Ti-6Al-4V 的耐磨性，而随机森林最能根据滑动条件预测磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该工作支持采用爆炸喷涂陶瓷涂层来延长 Ti-6Al-4V 构件在航空航天、生物医学和海洋摩擦学应用中的服役寿命。

按照 ASTM G99 进行销盘式磨损试验，在 40–100 N、100–200 rpm 和 20–40 min 条件下，以 EN31 钢为对磨材料评估磨损。
训练 ANN、KNN 和随机森林模型，将滑动参数映射到磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验显微观察显示涂层样品的磨损减轻并形成摩擦层，而在所测试模型中，随机森林具有最低的平均百分误差和均方误差。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能仅在有限的试验矩阵和特定的涂层/工艺窗口内得到验证，因此对其他载荷、速度、基体或服役环境的更广泛泛化仍需进一步验证。

title: Hot corrosion behavior of thermal sprayed using HVAF and DS techniques with Tribaloy-400 coatings for solar energy storage container
authors: P. Sakthivel, G. Sivakumar, M. Manikandan
abstract: The present study investigates the high-temperature corrosion behaviour of Tribaloy-400 (T-400) coatings deposited on ASTM A516 steel using two thermal spray techniques: (i) High Velocity Air Fuel (HVAF) spraying and (ii) Detonation Spraying (DS). The coated specimens were exposed to a molten solar salt environment consisting of 60% NaNO 3 –40% KNO 3 at 500 °C for exposure durations up to 1000 hours to evaluate their oxidation and corrosion resistance. Phase analysis indicated the formation of stable protective oxide phases, including Cr 2 O 3 , Co 3 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , in both coating systems. Elemental mapping revealed that the HVAF coating retained a uniform Cr–Mo–Si–O enriched surface with minimal molten salt penetration even after prolonged exposure of 1000 hours. In contrast, the DS coating exhibited comparatively deeper salt ingress into the coating microstructure, which contributed to increased degradation and spallation. SEM observations showed that the HVAF coatings possessed a dense and well-bonded microstructure, along with the formation of thermodynamically stable oxides such as Cr 2 O 3 , CoCr 2 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , resulting in superior resistance to molten salt-induced corrosion. However, the relatively porous nature of the DS coating promoted salt-assisted oxide dissolution, leading to higher mass gain, increased spallation, and accelerated degradation during extended exposure. Comparative evaluation of both coating techniques was carried out to identify a suitable coating process and feedstock combination for high-temperature CSP applications.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed Tribaloy-400 forms a denser, more protective oxide layer than detonation-sprayed Tribaloy-400, giving better resistance to molten solar-salt corrosion at 500 °C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For concentrated solar power thermal-storage containers, HVAF T-400 coatings appear more suitable than DS coatings for extending service life under long-term hot-corrosion exposure.
method: Tribaloy-400 was deposited on ASTM A516 steel using HVAF and detonation spraying.
Coated samples were exposed to 60% NaNO3–40% KNO3 molten salt at 500 °C for up to 1000 h.
Phase, SEM, and elemental-mapping analyses were used to compare oxide formation, salt ingress, and coating degradation.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that HVAF retained a uniform Cr–Mo–Si–O enriched surface with minimal salt penetration after 1000 h, while DS showed deeper salt ingress, higher mass gain, and more spallation.
infographic.watch_item: The result is specific to one coating composition, one substrate, and one molten-salt chemistry, so performance may differ under other CSP operating conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Hot corrosion behavior of thermal sprayed using HVAF and DS techniques with Tribaloy-400 coatings for solar energy storage container

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVAF和DS技术制备的Tribaloy-400涂层在太阳能储能容器中的热腐蚀行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用两种热喷涂技术沉积在ASTM A516钢上的Tribaloy-400（T-400）涂层的高温腐蚀行为：(i) 高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAF）和(ii) 爆炸喷涂（DS）。将涂覆试样暴露于由60% NaNO 3 –40% KNO 3 组成的熔融太阳盐环境中，在500 °C下暴露最长达1000小时，以评估其氧化和耐腐蚀性能。相分析表明，两种涂层体系中均形成了稳定的保护性氧化物相，包括Cr 2 O 3 、Co 3 O 4 和CoMoO 4 。元素映射显示，即使在暴露1000小时后，HVAF涂层仍保持均匀的富Cr–Mo–Si–O表面，且熔盐渗透极少。相比之下，DS涂层表现出较深的盐侵入涂层显微结构，这导致了更严重的劣化和剥落。SEM观察表明，HVAF涂层具有致密且结合良好的显微结构，同时形成了热力学稳定的氧化物，如Cr 2 O 3 、CoCr 2 O 4 和CoMoO 4 ，从而对熔盐引起的腐蚀表现出更优异的抗性。然而，DS涂层相对多孔的特性促进了盐辅助的氧化物溶解，导致更高的增重、更多的剥落以及在长时间暴露期间更快的劣化。为确定适用于高温CSP应用的合适涂层工艺与供料组合，对两种涂层技术进行了比较评价。

infographic.key_insight: 与爆炸喷涂的Tribaloy-400相比，HVAF喷涂的Tribaloy-400形成更致密、更具保护性的氧化层，因此在500 °C下对熔融太阳盐腐蚀具有更好的抵抗能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于聚光太阳能热储能容器而言，与DS涂层相比，HVAF T-400涂层更适合在长期热腐蚀暴露下延长服役寿命。
method: 使用HVAF和爆炸喷涂将Tribaloy-400沉积在ASTM A516钢上。
将涂层样品在500 °C下暴露于60% NaNO3–40% KNO3熔融盐中，最长达1000 h。
采用相分析、SEM和元素映射分析比较氧化物形成、盐侵入和涂层劣化。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，HVAF在1000 h后仍保持均匀的富Cr–Mo–Si–O表面，且盐渗透极少，而DS则表现出更深的盐侵入、更高的增重和更多的剥落。
infographic.watch_item: 该结果仅针对一种涂层成分、一种基体和一种熔盐化学体系，因此在其他CSP运行条件下性能可能会不同。

title: Effect of Barrel Filling Ratio on the Microstructure, Phase Composition and Tribological Performance of Detonation-Sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr Coatings
authors: Zhuldyz Sagdoldina, Aiym Nabioldina, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov, Gulsym Bektasova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of barrel filling ratio on the microstructure, phase composition, and tribological performance of detonation-sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings. Coatings were deposited at barrel filling ratios of 43% and 53% under identical spraying conditions. Microstructural characterization revealed the formation of dense lamellar coatings with low porosity and uniform distribution of Cr3C2 carbide particles within the NiCr metallic matrix. Compared with the coating deposited at a barrel filling ratio of 43%, the coating deposited at 53% exhibited a denser microstructure. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed that Cr3C2 and NiCr remained the dominant phases after spraying, while a minor amount of Cr7C3 formed due to partial decarburization of chromium carbide during thermal exposure. Tribological performance was evaluated under dry sliding conditions using a ball-on-disc configuration at normal loads of 10 and 15 N and sliding speeds of 5 and 10 cm/s. Wear volume was determined from the geometry of the wear track after testing, and wear rate was calculated accordingly. The coating produced at a barrel filling ratio of 53% demonstrated improved wear resistance under elevated loads despite exhibiting a higher coefficient of friction. The minimum wear rate reached 1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N), which was associated with reduced porosity and enhanced structural integrity of the coating. The obtained results demonstrate that optimization of detonation spraying parameters significantly affects coating structure and tribological behavior. The developed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings are promising protective materials for components operating under severe friction and wear conditions, including industrial and high-temperature engineering applications.

infographic.key_insight: Raising the barrel filling ratio from 43% to 53% made detonation-sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings denser and more wear-resistant, though with a slightly higher friction coefficient.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical parts, tuning detonation-spraying fill ratio is a practical way to improve coating integrity and service life under heavy sliding contact.
method: Detonation-sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings at 43% and 53% barrel filling ratios.
Compared microstructure and phase composition using microscopy and X-ray diffraction.
Ran dry ball-on-disc tribology tests at 10 and 15 N and 5 and 10 cm/s.
infographic.evidence_signal: The 53% coating showed the lowest wear rate, reaching 1.23 × 10^-4 mm3/(m·N), with denser structure and lower porosity than the 43% coating.
infographic.watch_item: Improved wear resistance came with higher friction, so the best fill ratio may depend on whether the application prioritizes low wear, low friction, or both.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of Barrel Filling Ratio on the Microstructure, Phase Composition and Tribological Performance of Detonation-Sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 药筒填充率对爆炸喷涂 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层微观组织、相组成和摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了药筒填充率对爆炸喷涂 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层微观组织、相组成和摩擦学性能的影响。在相同喷涂条件下，分别以 43% 和 53% 的药筒填充率制备涂层。微观组织表征显示，涂层形成了致密的层片状结构，孔隙率低，Cr3C2 碳化物颗粒在 NiCr 金属基体中分布均匀。与药筒填充率为 43% 时制备的涂层相比，53% 时制备的涂层具有更致密的微观组织。X 射线衍射分析证实，喷涂后 Cr3C2 和 NiCr 仍为主导相，而由于热暴露过程中铬碳化物发生部分脱碳，形成了少量 Cr7C3。摩擦学性能在干滑动条件下采用球-盘配置进行评估，法向载荷为 10 和 15 N，滑动速度为 5 和 10 cm/s。磨损体积根据试验后磨痕的几何形貌确定，并据此计算磨损率。药筒填充率为 53% 的涂层在较高载荷下表现出更好的耐磨性，尽管其摩擦系数更高。最小磨损率达到 1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N)，这与更低的孔隙率和更高的涂层结构完整性有关。结果表明，爆炸喷涂参数的优化会显著影响涂层结构和摩擦学行为。所制备的 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层有望作为在严苛摩擦磨损条件下工作的部件的防护材料，包括工业和高温工程应用。

infographic.key_insight: 将药筒填充率从 43% 提高到 53%，使爆炸喷涂 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层更致密、耐磨性更好，但摩擦系数略有升高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨关键部件，调整爆炸喷涂填充率是一种在重载滑动接触条件下提高涂层完整性和服役寿命的实用方法。
method: 在 43% 和 53% 的药筒填充率下爆炸喷涂 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层。
采用显微镜和 X 射线衍射分析微观组织和相组成。
在 10 和 15 N 以及 5 和 10 cm/s 条件下进行了干式球-盘摩擦学试验。
infographic.evidence_signal: 53% 涂层表现出最低磨损率，达到 1.23 × 10^-4 mm3/(m·N)，且其结构更致密、孔隙率低于 43% 涂层。
infographic.watch_item: 更好的耐磨性伴随着更高的摩擦，因此最佳填充率可能取决于应用更重视低磨损、低摩擦，还是两者兼顾。

title: Optimising Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing: Pressure-driven enhancement of mechanical performance in copper deposits
authors: Steven Camilleri, Thi Thuy Tien Tran, Keita Nomoto, Andrew Duguid, Matthew Harbidge, Riyan Rashid
abstract: Cold spray additive manufacturing (CSAM) is a solid-state process capable of producing dense metallic components without melting, making it highly attractive for copper applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical integrity. In this study, the influence of spray pressure at 30 bar, 40 bar, 50 bar and 60 bar on particle velocity, microstructure, and properties of cold-sprayed copper was systematically investigated using a LightSPEE3D system. The cold spray deposits were characterised by X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing, eddy current conductivity, tensile evaluation, and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results reveal that increasing spray pressure enhances particle velocities beyond the critical threshold for copper, leading to improved inter-particle bonding and microstructural refinement consistent with severe plastic deformation and possible continuous dynamic recrystallisation (cDRX)-assisted mechanisms. XRD analysis suggested progressive crystallite refinement and increased dislocation density with pressure, which directly correlated with improved ductility. While hardness decreased due to recovery and recrystallisation, electrical conductivity increased, likely due to improved inter-particle continuity and reduced interfacial discontinuities. Tensile testing showed a clear strength-ductility transition, with deposits at higher pressures exhibiting substantially improved ductility approaching bulk copper behaviour and fully ductile fracture morphologies. Overall, the findings identify an optimum processing window at higher spray pressures, where copper cold spray deposits achieve a balanced combination of conductivity, ductility, and strength. This study highlights the critical role of spray pressure in controlling the interplay between particle velocity, dynamic recrystallisation, and multifunctional performance in CSAM copper components. This study establishes a process-structure-property relationship linking particle velocity, XRD-derived microstructural evolution, conductivity, and tensile behaviour within a LightSPEE3D CSAM system.

infographic.key_insight: Higher cold-spray pressure raises copper particle velocity above the bonding threshold, improving inter-particle bonding and ductility while preserving good conductivity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study identifies a practical pressure window for producing copper CSAM parts with a better balance of mechanical performance and electrical conductivity for functional components.
method: Cold-sprayed copper at 30, 40, 50, and 60 bar using a LightSPEE3D system.
Characterised deposits by XRD, SEM, hardness, eddy current conductivity, and tensile testing.
Compared microstructure and property changes against spray pressure-driven particle velocity changes.
infographic.evidence_signal: Data showed progressive crystallite refinement, higher dislocation density, increased conductivity, lower hardness, and a clear strength-to-ductility transition at higher pressures.
infographic.watch_item: Higher-pressure settings may improve ductility and bonding, but process optimisation is needed to avoid over-softening from recovery/recrystallisation or pressure-specific variability.
infographic.paper_title: Optimising Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing: Pressure-driven enhancement of mechanical performance in copper deposits

zh-Hans.title: 优化冷喷涂增材制造：压力驱动提升铜沉积层的力学性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 冷喷涂增材制造（CSAM）是一种固态工艺，能够在不发生熔化的情况下制备致密金属部件，因此对于同时要求电导率和机械完整性的铜应用具有很强吸引力。本研究采用 LightSPEE3D 系统，系统考察了喷涂压力在 30 bar、40 bar、50 bar 和 60 bar 下对冷喷铜颗粒速度、显微组织和性能的影响。通过 X 射线衍射（XRD）、硬度测试、涡流电导率测量、拉伸评估和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）对冷喷沉积层进行表征。结果表明，提高喷涂压力会使颗粒速度超过铜的临界阈值，从而增强颗粒间结合，并促使显微组织细化，这与严重塑性变形以及可能由连续动态再结晶（cDRX）辅助的机制一致。XRD 分析表明，随着压力升高，晶粒尺寸持续细化且位错密度增加，这与延展性的改善直接相关。尽管由于回复和再结晶导致硬度下降，但电导率有所提高，这可能归因于颗粒间连续性增强以及界面不连续性减少。拉伸测试显示出明显的强度-延性转变，高压力下制备的沉积层展现出显著提升的延性，接近块体铜的行为，并呈现完全延性断裂形貌。总体而言，研究结果表明，在较高喷涂压力下存在一个最佳工艺窗口，铜冷喷沉积层可在电导率、延性和强度之间实现平衡组合。本研究强调了喷涂压力在调控颗粒速度、动态再结晶以及 CSAM 铜部件多功能性能之间相互作用中的关键作用。本研究建立了一个工艺-组织-性能关系，将 LightSPEE3D CSAM 系统中的颗粒速度、基于 XRD 的显微组织演化、电导率和拉伸行为联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 更高的冷喷涂压力会使铜颗粒速度超过结合阈值，从而增强颗粒间结合并提高延性，同时保持良好的电导率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究确定了一个可行的压力窗口，可用于制备机械性能与电导率平衡更佳的铜 CSAM 功能部件。
method: 使用 LightSPEE3D 系统在 30、40、50 和 60 bar 下进行冷喷铜沉积。
采用 XRD、SEM、硬度、涡流电导率和拉伸测试对沉积层进行表征。
将显微组织和性能变化与喷涂压力驱动的颗粒速度变化进行比较。
infographic.evidence_signal: 数据表明，随着压力升高，晶粒尺寸持续细化、位错密度增加、电导率提高、硬度降低，并出现明显的强度向延性转变。
infographic.watch_item: 更高压力设置可能有助于提高延性和结合强度，但仍需进行工艺优化，以避免由于回复/再结晶导致的过度软化或不同压力条件下的波动。

title: EFFECT OF ARGON FLOW RATE DURING AIR PLASMA SPRAYING ON THE STRUCTURE AND PROPERTIES OF NICRFEBSIC COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurkhat Bimakhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov
abstract: In this work, self-fluxing metal-ceramic coatings based on the NiCrFeBSiC system were obtained by air plasma spraying, and their structural, mechanical, and tribological properties were investigated.. The effect of argon flow rate (1600 and 1800 L/h) during coating formation was consideredIt was found that an increase in argon flow rate leads to an approximately twofold increase in coating thickness and a twofold decrease in porosity. According to the microhardness measurement results, the microhardness was 1015.8 ± 81.5 HV, while the elastic modulus was 203.9 ± 5.4 GPa. Tribological tests were carried out using the ball-on-disk configurationAt an argon flow rate of 1800 L/h, the friction coefficient showed a lower value (≈0.107), indicating improved wear resistance of the coatings. Scratch test results showed a high level of adhesion between the coatings and the substrate. Although the critical load values (Lc) were similar for both regimes, the coatings obtained at 1800 L/h exhibited a more gradual and stable failure behavior.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Increasing argon flow rate from 1600 to 1800 L/h during air plasma spraying of NiCrFeBSiC coatings produces thicker, denser coatings with better tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing plasma-spray gas flow is a practical lever for improving coating quality, wear resistance, and adhesion in thermal-spray surface engineering.
method: Air plasma sprayed self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC metal-ceramic coatings on a substrate
Compared two argon flow rates: 1600 and 1800 L/h
Evaluated microstructure, microhardness, elastic modulus, friction, and scratch adhesion
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports about a twofold increase in coating thickness and a twofold decrease in porosity at 1800 L/h, with friction coefficient dropping to about 0.107 and strong scratch-test adhesion.
infographic.watch_item: Results are based on only two argon flow settings, so the observed improvement may not capture the full process window or long-term service behavior.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF ARGON FLOW RATE DURING AIR PLASMA SPRAYING ON THE STRUCTURE AND PROPERTIES OF NICRFEBSIC COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 空气等离子喷涂过程中氩气流量对NiCrFeBSiC涂层结构和性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本工作采用空气等离子喷涂制备了基于NiCrFeBSiC体系的自熔性金属陶瓷涂层，并研究了其结构、力学和摩擦学性能。考察了涂层形成过程中氩气流量（1600和1800 L/h）的影响。结果表明，随着氩气流量增加，涂层厚度约增加两倍，孔隙率降低两倍。根据显微硬度测试结果，显微硬度为1015.8 ± 81.5 HV，而弹性模量为203.9 ± 5.4 GPa。采用球-盘配置进行了摩擦学测试。在氩气流量为1800 L/h时，摩擦系数较低（≈0.107），表明涂层的耐磨性有所提高。划痕测试结果显示涂层与基体之间具有较高的结合强度。尽管两种工况下的临界载荷值（Lc）相近，但在1800 L/h条件下获得的涂层表现出更为逐渐且稳定的失效行为。

infographic.key_insight: 在空气等离子喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层过程中，将氩气流量从1600提高到1800 L/h，可获得更厚、更致密且摩擦学性能更好的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化等离子喷涂气体流量是提高热喷涂表面工程中涂层质量、耐磨性和结合强度的实用手段。
method: 在基体上进行空气等离子喷涂自熔性NiCrFeBSiC金属陶瓷涂层
比较两种氩气流量：1600和1800 L/h
评估微观结构、显微硬度、弹性模量、摩擦性能和划痕结合强度
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，在1800 L/h时涂层厚度约增加两倍、孔隙率约降低两倍，摩擦系数降至约0.107，并且划痕测试显示出较强的结合强度。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅基于两种氩气流量设置，因此观察到的性能提升可能未覆盖完整工艺窗口或长期服役行为。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: For predicting welding outputs, stacking ensemble learning achieved higher task-specific accuracy than multitask neural networks, while MTNN still captured shared patterns across related targets well.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results help engineers choose between a generalizable multi-output model and a more precise task-specific predictor when estimating UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
method: Compared multitask neural network (shared hidden layers + task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding performance metrics: UTS, weld bead hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated performance using RMSE and R² across the shared dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: MTNN reported RMSE/R² of 0.1288/0.6724 for UTS, 0.0886/0.9215 for weld hardness, and 0.1125/0.8407 for HAZ hardness, while stacking improved to 0.0263/0.9863, 0.0467/0.9782, and 0.1109/0.8453, respectively.
infographic.watch_item: The better-performing stacking model may be more task-specific and potentially less suitable than MTNN when data are sparse or when shared-task generalization is the priority.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 焊接应用中用于预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和HAZ机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计为同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL不为每个任务分别训练独立模型，而是在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于共享数据集，对两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，进行了比较，以预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定类型的多任务学习（MTL）模型，它使用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用RMSE和R<sup>2</sup>进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。结果表明其具有较强的预测能力，其RMSE分别为UTS的0.1288、焊缝硬度的0.0886以及HAZ硬度的0.1125，而R<sup>2</sup>值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这说明其能够在相互关联的任务中表现出良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的准确性方面优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263、R<sup>2</sup>为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467、R<sup>2</sup>为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109、R<sup>2</sup>为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法具有产生高精度、任务特定预测的良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够提供高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要高精度、相互独立预测的情况下表现更佳。总体而言，两者都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，使其适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前置方案，以结合两种方法的最佳特性。

infographic.key_insight: 在焊接输出预测中，堆叠集成学习在任务特定准确性方面优于多任务神经网络，而MTNN仍能较好地捕捉相关目标之间的共享模式。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果帮助工程师在估计UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度时，在更具泛化能力的多输出模型与更精确的任务特定预测器之间做出选择。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层 + 任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
预测三种焊接性能指标：UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度。
使用RMSE和R²在共享数据集上评估性能。
infographic.watch_item: 表现更好的堆叠模型可能更具任务特异性，因此在数据稀疏或优先考虑共享任务泛化时，可能不如MTNN适用。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings form denser, fine-lamellar microstructures with better long-term corrosion and wear performance when droplet spread is high and porosity is low.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray parameters and humidity exposure can improve the durability of Fe-based protective coatings on carbon steel in corrosive and tribological service.
method: Detonation spray Fe-based amorphous coatings onto Q235 carbon steel under different spraying parameters.
Compare coating microstructure, porosity, corrosion resistance, and wear behavior across humidity environments.
Evaluate tribo-chemical effects during sliding against Si3N4 balls in the presence of water molecules.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic corrosion and tribology testing and shows that higher porosity lowers long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces both friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.watch_item: The performance gains depend strongly on spray quality and environmental humidity, so coating reliability may drop if porosity defects or service conditions are not well controlled.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上于不同喷涂参数下成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆形度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成具有致密微观结构的细片层结构涂层至关重要。涂层中较高的孔隙缺陷发生率与较低的长期耐腐蚀性相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应在涂层磨损行为中起着重要作用。随着湿度条件升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 当液滴铺展较大且孔隙率较低时，爆炸喷涂铁基非晶涂层可形成更致密的细片层微观结构，并表现出更好的长期耐腐蚀性和耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂参数和湿度暴露条件可提高碳钢上铁基防护涂层在腐蚀和摩擦服役环境中的耐久性。
method: 在不同喷涂参数下，将铁基非晶涂层通过爆炸喷涂制备于Q235碳钢上。
比较不同湿度环境下涂层的微观结构、孔隙率、耐腐蚀性和磨损行为。
评估在水分子存在下与Si3N4球滑动接触过程中的摩擦化学效应。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了系统的腐蚀和摩擦学测试，并表明较高孔隙率会降低长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度增加会降低摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.watch_item: 性能提升高度依赖喷涂质量和环境湿度，因此如果孔隙缺陷或服役条件未得到良好控制，涂层可靠性可能下降。

title: Multilayer Self‐Limiting Electrospray Deposition via Stepped Voltage Bias
authors: Madhuri Deb, S. Rahman Pejman, Alexander Jakimowicz, Jonathan P. Singer
abstract: The self‐limiting regime of electrospray deposition (SLED) is a highly adaptable means to coat complex 3D architectures and 2D templated surfaces. There are, however, drawbacks to this approach, including that (1) SLED coatings cannot be applied in multiple layers and (2) the generally micron‐scale thickness of SLED coatings is determined by the material and spray parameters, preventing nanoscale coatings such as those possible by atomic layer deposition or spin coating. This latter limitation can be circumvented by applying a secondary bias to the spray target, which reduces the SLED thickness and increases uniformity. Here, we demonstrate that the stepwise removal of bias can, in turn, result in the stepwise increase of the SLED thickness. We thereby demonstrate (i) tri‐layer polystyrene stacks with bias‐controlled thickness, (ii) uniform tri‐layer coatings on a complex geometry, and (iii) a mechanically robust nanocomposite using thermal capillary rise infiltration (CaRI) of electrosprayed bilayer films.

infographic.key_insight: Stepped target-bias control turns self-limiting electrospray deposition into a multilayer process, enabling thickness to increase layer-by-layer instead of being fixed by one spray pass.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This provides a practical route to conformal, bias-tunable coatings on complex 3D surfaces, bridging electrospray deposition with nanoscale-to-microscale film design for advanced coatings and composites.
method: Apply electrospray deposition in the self-limiting regime.
Use a secondary target bias to reduce and tune deposited thickness.
Remove bias stepwise to build tri-layer and multilayer stacks; combine with capillary rise infiltration for robust nanocomposites.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports tri-layer polystyrene stacks with bias-controlled thickness, uniform tri-layer coatings on complex geometry, and mechanically robust nanocomposites after CaRI infiltration.
infographic.watch_item: Thickness and uniformity depend on precise voltage stepping and spray/material parameters, so reproducibility and process control may be sensitive to setup calibration.
infographic.paper_title: Multilayer Self‐Limiting Electrospray Deposition via Stepped Voltage Bias

zh-Hans.title: 通过阶梯式电压偏置实现多层自限制静电喷雾沉积
zh-Hans.abstract: 静电喷雾沉积（electrospray deposition, SLED）的自限制工作区是一种高度灵活的方法，可用于在复杂的三维结构和二维模板化表面上进行涂覆。然而，这种方法也存在一些缺点，包括：(1) SLED 涂层不能以多层形式施加；(2) SLED 涂层通常为微米尺度厚度，其厚度由材料和喷涂参数决定，从而无法获得原子层沉积或旋涂所能实现的纳米尺度涂层。后一限制可通过在喷涂靶上施加二次偏压来规避，该偏压可降低 SLED 厚度并提高均匀性。在此，我们证明，逐步去除偏压反过来可导致 SLED 厚度逐步增加。因此，我们展示了：(i) 通过偏压控制厚度的三层聚苯乙烯堆叠；(ii) 在复杂几何结构上的均匀三层涂层；以及 (iii) 采用静电喷涂双层薄膜的热毛细上升浸渗（CaRI）制备的机械稳健纳米复合材料。

infographic.key_insight: 阶梯式靶偏压控制将自限制静电喷雾沉积转变为多层过程，使厚度能够逐层增加，而不是由单次喷涂固定。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为复杂三维表面上的共形、可由偏压调控的涂层提供了一条实用路径，将静电喷雾沉积与从纳米尺度到微米尺度的薄膜设计连接起来，适用于先进涂层和复合材料。
method: 在自限制工作区进行静电喷雾沉积。
使用二次靶偏压来降低并调控沉积厚度。
通过逐步去除偏压构建三层和多层堆叠；结合毛细上升浸渗以制备稳健纳米复合材料。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报道了通过偏压控制厚度的三层聚苯乙烯堆叠、复杂几何结构上的均匀三层涂层，以及 CaRI 浸渗后的机械稳健纳米复合材料。
infographic.watch_item: 厚度和均匀性取决于精确的电压阶梯和喷涂/材料参数，因此可重复性和工艺控制可能对装置校准较为敏感。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized DDFW parameters substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, while deep learning can predict tensile performance from process settings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger lightweight aluminum joints for aerospace and automotive assemblies by pairing geometry-driven mechanical interlocking with data-driven process optimization.
method: Used an L18 orthogonal array to test friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, joint geometry, and friction time.
Compared conventional flat-to-flat joints against a novel drilled-to-bossed geometry inspired by mortise-and-tenon design.
Trained deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, to predict ultimate tensile strength from welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The best condition achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, and the top prediction model reached about R² = 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The reported predictive accuracy is moderate, so broader validation on more datasets and operating conditions would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔凸台几何与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊中的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要　航空航天和汽车工业对轻质、高强度材料日益增长的需求，使得AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。文中引入了一种受传统榫卯接头启发的新型钻孔凸台几何，以增强机械锁合并提高焊缝完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计实验，评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在定制发动机车床上进行，摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间被选为可控工艺参数。与此同时，实施了先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，用于基于焊接条件预测极限拉伸强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔凸台几何以及4 min摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出优异的力学性能，拉伸强度达到538 MPa，扭转强度达到325 MPa。与传统平对平接头相比，钻孔凸台结构显示出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高的预测精度，R²值约为0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔凸台接头几何与优化后的DDFW参数相结合，可显著提升AA2024-T351焊接强度，而深度学习能够根据工艺设定预测拉伸性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将几何驱动的机械锁合与数据驱动的工艺优化相结合，为航空航天和汽车装配中的高强轻质铝接头提供了一条实用路径。
method: 使用L18正交表测试摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接头几何形状和摩擦时间。
将传统平对平接头与受榫卯设计启发的新型钻孔凸台几何进行比较。
训练包括集成残差网络在内的深度学习模型，以根据焊接条件预测极限拉伸强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳条件下拉伸强度达到538 MPa、扭转强度达到325 MPa，且最佳预测模型的R²约为0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的预测精度属中等水平，因此在部署前需要在更多数据集和运行条件下进行更广泛的验证。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation spraying parameters can be tuned to control titanium dioxide-based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with clear optimal settings for maximum water repellency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported scaling laws and predictive equations can guide process selection in coating production to target surface finish and functional wetting behavior.
method: Varied detonation spraying process conditions, especially nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Measured coating surface roughness, thickness, and contact angle to quantify surface characteristics.
Derived empirical relationships linking process parameters to surface properties, including inverse power and parabolic dependencies.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimental observation and model fitting of coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle versus process parameters, leading to optimized hydrophobicity conditions.
infographic.watch_item: The relationships appear empirical and may be specific to the studied materials and spraying setup, so transferability to other systems should be validated.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同工艺条件下获得的钛基涂层表面特征
zh-Hans.abstract: 描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性质随爆炸喷涂条件变化的规律。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等性质可在生产过程中通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定取值加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最佳取值，可保证所制备涂层具有最大的疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度依照反幂律与喷嘴通过速度相关。粗糙度和接触角依照抛物线规律与喷涂距离相关。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面的特征，以及确定涂层喷涂的最佳工况，从而保证其最佳疏水性。

infographic.key_insight: 可通过调节爆炸喷涂参数控制二氧化钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性，并存在实现最大疏水性的明确最优参数设置。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 文中给出的标度定律和预测方程可用于涂层制备中的工艺选择，以获得目标表面形貌和功能性润湿行为。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂工艺条件，重点考察喷嘴通过速度和喷涂距离。
测量涂层表面粗糙度、厚度和接触角，以量化表面特征。
建立工艺参数与表面性质之间的经验关系，包括反幂律和抛物线依赖关系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了对涂层粗糙度、厚度和接触角随工艺参数变化的实验观察与模型拟合，并据此确定了优化的疏水性条件。
infographic.watch_item: 这些关系似乎是经验性的，可能仅适用于所研究的材料和喷涂装置，因此其向其他系统的迁移性需要验证。

title: Effects of electron beam welding on the microstructure and impact properties of three reconstituted steels
authors: HU Minglei, HU Bin, ZHANG Wei, LIU Xiaoou, DAI Kunjie, NI Xiaoqing
abstract: Specimen reconstitution technology is important for the in-service safety of reactor pressure vessels (RPVs) in nuclear power plants. To verify the feasibility of electron beam welding for the restructured specimens, the electron beam welding to restructure the 16MND5, 10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN, and X6NiCrTiMoVB 25-15-2 Charpy impact specimens for three kinds of steels was adopted, the microstructure and mechanical properties of the restructured specimens were characterized, and the Vickers hardness and impact toughness of the specimens were tested by non-destructive flaw detection, optical microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy. The results show that the microstructure of these three steels in weld zone is relatively dense, and no obvious crack defects occur. The welding quality of 10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN restructured specimens is the best, and the mechanical properties are relatively close to those of the original specimens, demonstrating that the electron beam welding has the good application potential of reconstitution in nuclear power field.

infographic.key_insight: Electron beam welding can successfully reconstruct Charpy impact specimens for reactor-pressure-vessel steels, producing dense weld zones with no obvious cracking and preserving near-original mechanical performance, especially for 10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This supports specimen reconstitution for nuclear materials qualification, reducing the need for full-size test material while maintaining confidence in impact and hardness assessments.
method: Electron-beam welded restructured Charpy specimens for 16MND5, 10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN, and X6NiCrTiMoVB 25-15-2 steels.
Evaluated weld quality and microstructure using non-destructive flaw detection, optical microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy.
Measured Vickers hardness and impact toughness to compare restructured specimens with original specimens.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports dense weld-zone microstructures without obvious cracks, and the 10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN specimens showed the best weld quality with properties closest to the originals.
infographic.watch_item: Results are limited to the tested specimen types and conditions, so broader applicability requires validation across more steels, weld parameters, and service-relevant loading conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 电子束焊接对三种重构钢微观组织和冲击性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 样品重构技术对核电站反应堆压力容器（RPVs）的服役安全具有重要意义。为验证电子束焊接用于重构试样的可行性，采用电子束焊接对三种钢的16MND5、10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN和X6NiCrTiMoVB 25-15-2 Charpy冲击试样进行重构，并对重构试样的微观组织和力学性能进行了表征，同时通过无损探伤、光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜测试了试样的维氏硬度和冲击韧性。结果表明，这三种钢在焊接区的微观组织较为致密，未出现明显裂纹缺陷。10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN重构试样的焊接质量最好，其力学性能与原始试样较为接近，表明电子束焊接在核电领域具有良好的重构应用潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 电子束焊接可成功重构反应堆压力容器钢的Charpy冲击试样，形成致密、无明显裂纹的焊接区，并能保持接近原始的力学性能，尤其适用于10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为核材料资格鉴定中的试样重构提供了支持，可减少对全尺寸试验材料的需求，同时保持对冲击和硬度评估的可信度。
method: 采用电子束焊接对16MND5、10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN和X6NiCrTiMoVB 25-15-2钢的Charpy重构试样进行焊接。
使用无损探伤、光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜评估焊接质量和微观组织。
测量维氏硬度和冲击韧性，以将重构试样与原始试样进行比较。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告焊接区微观组织致密且无明显裂纹，且10Cr12Ni3Mo2VN试样的焊接质量最好，性能最接近原始试样。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅限于所测试的试样类型和条件，因此更广泛的适用性仍需在更多钢种、焊接参数和服役相关载荷条件下进行验证。

title: High-temperature oxidation kinetics and microstructural evolution of detonation-sprayed AlCuFe quasicrystalline coatings
authors: Xinran Li, Yi-Xiang Wang, Maxingwang Lu, Yongchao Fang
abstract: To solve the susceptibility of TC4 titanium alloys to high-temperature oxidation and subsequent performance degradation, AlCuFe quasicrystalline (QC) coatings were successfully fabricated via detonation spraying (DS) as a functional protective barrier. The oxidation kinetics, phase evolution, and mechanical stability of the coating system were systematically investigated at 450°C in an atmospheric environment for up to 250 h. The results indicate that the oxidation kinetics strictly obey the parabolic growth law, yielding a steady-state parabolic rate constant ( k p ) of 1.83 × 10 −2 mg 2 ⋅ cm −4 ⋅ h −1 . Throughout the service period, the coating exhibits a significant “thermal hardening” effect, with the surface microhardness increasing from an initial 491 HV 0.2 to a final value of 665.2 HV 0.2 (a 35.5% increment). Phase evolution is characterized by an initial thermally induced ordering of metastable regions (0–3 h) followed by the gradual decomposition of the icosahedral (I) phase into approximant phases (β, τ, and λ) driven by the Al-depletion effect. Notably, the increased density of phase boundaries and intermetallic interfaces within the multi-phase network effectively sustains the mechanical performance despite the decline in the primary QC fraction. This study demonstrates that DS-AlCuFe coatings provide a reliable structural evolution pathway for the long-term high-temperature protection of titanium alloys.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed AlCuFe quasicrystalline coatings form a stable, oxidation-resistant barrier at 450°C by slowly transforming from icosahedral QC to multi-phase approximants while maintaining and even increasing hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The coating offers a promising long-term protective layer for TC4 titanium alloys in high-temperature oxidizing environments, helping preserve surface integrity and mechanical performance.
method: Fabricated AlCuFe QC coatings by detonation spraying (DS).
Aged the coatings in air at 450°C for up to 250 h.
Tracked oxidation kinetics, phase evolution, and microhardness over time.
infographic.evidence_signal: The oxidation followed a parabolic law with kp = 1.83 × 10^-2 mg^2·cm^-4·h^-1, while microhardness rose from 491 HV0.2 to 665.2 HV0.2 after 250 h.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is demonstrated at a single test temperature and atmosphere, so broader service conditions and coating-substrate durability still need validation.

zh-Hans.title: 爆轰喷涂 AlCuFe 准晶涂层的高温氧化动力学与微观结构演化
zh-Hans.abstract: 为解决 TC4 钛合金易发生高温氧化并随后导致性能退化的问题，采用爆轰喷涂（DS）成功制备了 AlCuFe 准晶（QC）涂层，作为一种功能性保护屏障。系统研究了该涂层体系在 450°C、大气环境下最长 250 h 的氧化动力学、相变演化及力学稳定性。结果表明，氧化动力学严格遵循抛物线生长定律，稳态抛物线速率常数（k p）为 1.83 × 10 −2 mg 2 ⋅ cm −4 ⋅ h −1。在整个服役期间，涂层表现出显著的“热硬化”效应，表面显微硬度由初始的 491 HV 0.2 提高至最终的 665.2 HV 0.2（增加 35.5%）。相演化特征表现为：首先在 0–3 h 内发生热诱导的亚稳区有序化，随后在 Al 枯竭效应驱动下，二十面体（I）相逐渐分解为近似相（β、τ 和 λ）。值得注意的是，多相网络中相界和金属间界面的密度增加，即使在主要 QC 含量下降的情况下，仍能有效维持其力学性能。本研究表明，DS-AlCuFe 涂层为钛合金长期高温防护提供了一条可靠的结构演化路径。

infographic.key_insight: 爆轰喷涂 AlCuFe 准晶涂层在 450°C 下通过缓慢由二十面体 QC 转变为多相近似相，形成稳定、耐氧化的屏障，同时保持并甚至提高硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层为 TC4 钛合金在高温氧化环境中的长期防护层提供了有前景的方案，有助于保持表面完整性和力学性能。
method: 采用爆轰喷涂（DS）制备 AlCuFe QC 涂层。
将涂层在 450°C 空气中时效最长 250 h。
随时间跟踪氧化动力学、相演化和显微硬度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 氧化遵循抛物线规律，kp = 1.83 × 10^-2 mg^2·cm^-4·h^-1，而显微硬度在 250 h 后由 491 HV0.2 升至 665.2 HV0.2。
infographic.watch_item: 性能仅在单一测试温度和气氛下得到验证，因此更广泛的服役条件以及涂层-基体耐久性仍需进一步验证。
